WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "signals"."rfistat" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "signals"  GROUP BY "signals"."rfistat"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m2" > "s4"."v") SELECT AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5"
